q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 14, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026.
**Time remaining: 12 days**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provides NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

This is not a forecast — this is the actual forward guidance NVIDIA has already provided as of May 20, 2026. The question asks what forward guidance NVIDIA will provide in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026.

The most direct interpretation is that the guidance already issued ($91.0B ± 2%) is what will be reported/reaffirmed, giving a range of $89.18B to $92.82B.

However, it's possible the question is asking whether NVIDIA might revise this guidance at the August 26 earnings call. Given:
- Only 12 days remain until the earnings call
- Guidance is typically finalized days/weeks before public release
- NVIDIA would not significantly change guidance between May and late August without material new information
- The May guidance was explicit ($91.0B ± 2%, with specific margin and opex guidance)

The probability that NVIDIA maintains the $91.0B guidance (or something very close to it) is very high.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Major market disruption or demand shortfall discovered in the last 12 days
- Unexpected geopolitical events affecting China export restrictions more severely
- Significant customer cancellations or project delays
- Macro deterioration requiring inventory corrections
- Manufacturing/supply chain issues

These are all low-probability events given the short timeframe and recent guidance setting.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI accelerators
- Accelerated customer deployments pulling forward revenue
- Better-than-expected data center orders
- New customer wins or expanded existing customer deployments
- Upward revision to reflect actual Q1 performance exceeding expectations

The May guidance was already significantly above analyst consensus ($86.84B), suggesting management confidence. Upward revision is possible but would require material positive developments.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion
- Q2 FY2027 forward guidance (May 20, 2026): $91.0 billion ± 2%
- This represents an 11.5% sequential increase from Q1 to guidance midpoint

The May guidance was issued with explicit caveats (no China Data Center compute revenue assumed) and came in well above consensus estimates, suggesting management confidence in the $91.0B figure.

---

## Reasoning

The forward guidance of $91.0 billion with a ±2% band has already been publicly issued by NVIDIA as of May 20, 2026. With only 12 days until the August 26 earnings call and no material negative information provided in the research, the most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will either:

1. Reaffirm the $91.0B ± 2% guidance
2. Provide guidance within or very close to this range

The range provided in the question (99.5B to 115.5B) has a midpoint of 107.5B, which is notably above the current guidance midpoint of 91.0B. This suggests the question may be testing whether conditions have changed significantly since May. However, given:

- The short timeframe (12 days)
- No material new information in the research beyond the May guidance
- Normal corporate guidance practices (not revising dramatically without major news)

I estimate the actual guidance will cluster tightly around the already-issued $91.0B, with most probability between $89.0B and $93.0B. The broader range in the question setup appears designed for a wider distribution, but the base case is strong reaffirmation of existing guidance.

q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA explicitly stated that this outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Gross margins are expected to be 74.9% (GAAP) and 75.0% (non-GAAP), plus or minus 50 basis points. Operating expenses are projected at approximately $8.5 billion (GAAP) and $8.3 billion (non-GAAP) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The Q1 FY2027 revenue, reported on May 20, 2026, was $81.6 billion [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The Q2 FY2027 results are scheduled for release on August 26, 2026 [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).
